A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Meat and Seafood Fry}}
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat and Seafood Fries can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Meat]] and [[Seafood]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made by using Seafood with contradicting effects. Alternatively, Seafood without any effects can be used, such as [[Hyrule Bass]]es and [[Sanke Carp]]. When eaten, these [[Meal]]s will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. These dishes are noted to be filling and have fresh [[Ingredient]]s. In [[The Old Man's Diary|his diary]], the [[Old Man]] writes about making Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry, claiming it restores health and keeps him warm in the cold.{{Cite|On this desolate plateau, the only pleasure that brings me comfort is cooking. And today, I outdid myself! Truly, I created the perfect dish. I call it... spicy meat and seafood fry. This recipe not only restores health, but it also keeps me warm, even when traveling in the snowy mountains.|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}} Using this dish, he claims he will no longer need his [[Warm Doublet]].{{Cite|With this dish on my side, I no longer have need of that itchy {{Color BotW|Blue|warm doublet}}.|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}} However, on the next page, he laments the fact that he did not write down the recipe, only remembering that he used Raw Meat and Spicy Peppers.{{Cite|I do not know how I allowed this to happen, but it seems I forgot to write down a very important recipe. I know it contained raw meat and spicy pepper. However... I simply cannot remember what else I used! My age is catching up to me.|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}} Though it seems unlikely to him, if anyone were to know the final Ingredient, he would give them his Warm Doublet.{{Cite|Sadly, on this lonely plateau, I have only my own knowledge and memory to rely on. Still... If I did find someone who knew the missing ingredient, I would happily reward them with my {{Color BotW|Blue|warm doublet}}. However, it seems unlikely that such a miraculous wish will ever be fulfilled.|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}} Link can make Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry for the Old Man, and he will be rewarded with a Warm Doublet if he shares the recipe.{{Cite|Wait... Is that... That looks just like my signature perfect dish, {{Color BotW|Blue|spicy meat and seafood fry}}! But how did you-?! Well, I suppose that is not important. Can I trouble you to share the recipe?|Old Man|BotW}}{{Cite|Well done! Now, please allow me to reward your culinary efforts with this warm doublet.|Old Man|BotW}} He will later write in his diary about how Link is a fine young man who he sees potential in, as well as transcribing the recipe.{{Cite|To my surprise and delight, I did happen upon someone who was able to re-create my spicy meat and seafood fry. I gave him my {{Color BotW|Blue|warm doublet}}, and I was happy to do so. He is a fine young man with great potential, that one. Ah, and I will now write down this perfect recipe so that I will never forget it. Place some raw meat, spicy pepper, and hyrule bass in a pot, and then turn up the heat. Voilà!|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}} Based on the type of Seafood used and whether additional Ingredients are added, the following variations of Meat and Seafood Fry can be made: * '''Chilly Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other cold Ingredients. These meals grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when consumed. * '''Electro Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electric Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when he eats these meals. * '''Enduring Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. When eaten, they will completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other energizing Ingredients. Eating them will fill a part of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. If eaten, they will increase Link's speed for a short period of time. * '''Hearty Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. These meals will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other mighty Ingredients. When eaten, they will increase Link's attack power. * '''Sneaky Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, they boost Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy Ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A filling dish made by cooking fresh seafood and meat together.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other tough Ingredients. They increase Link's [[Defense]] when he eats them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry * Meal * Prime Meat and Seafood Fry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
